jobs.title: Electrical Service Engineer
jobs.description:
**Electrical Service Engineer - Dublin Region (Field Based Role)**

**Reporting to:** Service Manager, EPS Group

**Base Location:** Naas, Co. Kildare

**About the Role**

We have an exciting opportunity for an Electrical Service Engineer to join our Service & Repairs team. The position will be based from our Naas branch; however, the successful candidate will be responsible for supporting municipal and industrial customers throughout the Dublin Region.

This role is ideally suited to a qualified electrician with 3 to 5 years' experience in the industrial, water and wastewater sector, focused on preventative and reactive maintenance activities.

Essential Requirement: Candidates must have proven experience working with wastewater treatment equipment, pumping stations, pumps and associated process equipment. Applications without relevant wastewater and pumping equipment experience will not be considered.

As part of our growing team, you will be responsible for the electrical maintenance and repair of municipal and industrial wastewater treatment plants, drinking water treatment plants, pumping stations and associated infrastructure throughout the Dublin Region.

This is a highly varied and challenging role offering invaluable exposure to a wide range of electrical, instrumentation and process equipment. No two days are the same, with work activities agreed on an ongoing basis with the Service Manager.

**Key Responsibilities**

Carry out preventative and reactive electrical maintenance within the water and wastewater industry.

Service, maintain and fault-find on wastewater pumping stations, treatment plants and associated infrastructure.

Carry out work on water and wastewater pumping and treatment installations, including instrumentation systems.

Calibration and servicing of on-site monitoring and instrumentation equipment.

Install, wire, commission and configure variable speed drives, DOL starters, star-delta starters and associated electrical equipment.

Diagnose faults and carry out repairs to pumps, motors, control panels and process equipment.

Liaise with Project Supervisors and Managers on electrical solutions and site implementation.

Complete service reports and documentation accurately and efficiently.

**Key Competencies and Skills**

Minimum 3 to 5 years' experience within the water or wastewater treatment industry.

Proven hands-on experience working with wastewater treatment processes, pumping stations, pumps and associated equipment is essential.

Ability to read control panel schematics and troubleshoot electrical control panel faults.

Strong technical knowledge of three-phase motors, pumps, dosing systems and associated instrumentation.

Experience working with pumps, motors, dosing equipment, control panels and instruments.

Familiarity with PLCs, automation and telemetry systems would be an advantage.

Proven ability to service, maintain and fault-find electrical systems, including verification of PLC inputs and outputs.

Good understanding of water and wastewater treatment processes.

Strong problem-solving and fault-finding skills.

Good computer and reporting skills.

Ability to work independently while providing excellent customer service.

**Qualifications**

Qualified Electrician with relevant electrical trade certification.

Full Irish/EU Driving Licence.

Safe Pass and Manual Handling Certification desirable.

Experience within the water and wastewater sector essential.

**Compensation Package:**

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Opportunities for professional development and career growth within a dynamic team or within a growing company
* CPD accredited employer
* A collaborative and supportive work environment
* Laptop or desktop and work mobile phone provided
* Flexible working options, dependent on location and role requirements
* See company website for more information on the many benefits to working in EPS Group

We welcome speculative applications from individuals of all levels.

**If you have any questions about this role or would like further information, please contact our recruiting team by emailing jobs@epswater.com.**

**Equal Opportunity Statement** - EPS Group is an equal opportunities employer.

**Company Profile**

*Since 1968, we have grown from a modest electrical and pumping services business and developed into an innovative, internationally exporting product and service provider, now focused upon the water, wastewater and clean technology sectors, operating across the Republic of Ireland, the UK and Northern Europe.*

*We are an international water infrastructure specialist, one of the few genuine end-to-end service providers in the global water sector, providing large scale employment, bringing market leading and ground breaking technologies to Ireland and working to improve the country's water infrastructure.*

*Our vision is to be the best and most rewarding place to work for our teams, to be our customer's outstanding partner of choice and we are committed to being a Net Zero, sustainable business.*

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a **Senior Machine Learning Engineer** with strong software engineering fundamentals who can seamlessly integrate Machine Learning and GenAI capabilities into scalable, production-grade applications.

  

This role is ideal for an experienced engineer (10+ years) who enjoys building end‑to‑end systems—including front-end, back-end, APIs, and ML‑powered services—rather than doing research.

  

You will partner closely with ML researchers, data scientists, and platform teams to transform prototypes, RAG pipelines, and agentic workflows into robust systems used across the enterprise.

  

**The Expertise We’re Looking For**

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field.
* 10+ years of professional software engineering experience (full stack, distributed systems, APIs, cloud).
* 4–6 years working with machine learning or GenAI systems in production environments.
* Experience designing and deploying RAG pipelines with embeddings and vector search.
* Hands-on with vector databases: FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, etc.
* Experience with agentic frameworks such as LangChain, CrewAI, LangGraph, AutoGen.
* Strong expertise in cloud-native engineering (AWS preferred).
* Proficient in modern front-end frameworks (React/Next.js, Angular, or similar) and in building robust web applications.
* Back-end development using Python (advanced) and one or more of: Node.js, Java, C#, or Go.
* Familiarity with traditional ML models, their applications, and how to integrate them into products.
* Cloud Platforms: AWS services such as S3, Lambda, ECS/EKS, SageMaker, API Gateway.
* Databases: Experience with relational systems (Oracle), cloud data warehouses (Snowflake), vector DBs, and knowledge graphs (Neo4j, RDF/SPARQL).
* DevOps: CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, infrastructure-as-code.
* Understanding of Responsible AI, data privacy, and ethical considerations in ML-driven systems.
* Good to have: Experience with model monitoring, evaluation frameworks, and automated alerting.
Ability to communicate architectural decisions and technical concepts to non-technical partners.  

  

**The Skills You Bring**

  

End-to-end engineering: You build full-stack applications that integrate ML/GenAI services seamlessly.

  

Productizing ML: Skilled at converting research notebooks and prototypes into production APIs, scalable microservices, or front‑end experiences.

  

System design & architecture: Comfortable with distributed systems, containerization, scaling, observability, and resilience.

  

ML/GenAI literacy: You understand how to select the right model type and integrate it appropriately into a business workflow.

  

Agentic workflows: Experience deploying multi-agent systems and monitoring their behavior in production.

  

Observability engineering: Hands-on with Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, and logging/metrics pipelines.

  

Engineering rigor: CI/CD, testing, version control, tracing, blue/green deployments, and secure coding practices.

  

Research & evaluation: Ability to evaluate new frameworks, GenAI tools, and emerging technologies for practical adoption.

  

Collaboration: Strong teamwork, mentorship, and communication, enabling strong cross-functional delivery.

  

**The Value You Deliver**

  

You build the full-stack components—APIs, UIs, services—that bring ML and GenAI capabilities directly into business applications.

  

You create scalable, secure, and reliable platforms for RAG, model serving, and agentic applications.

  

You improve engineering productivity by providing reusable patterns, libraries, and frameworks for ML integration.

  

You help the organization understand where different model types (LLMs, embeddings, classifiers, etc.) best fit business challenges.

  

You collaborate closely with ML researchers, product teams, and cloud engineering to deliver measurable business impact.

  

You elevate the team by sharing best practices in architecture, coding, and ML‑aware engineering

  

Click ' **Apply Now** ' to submit your resume or send directly to richard.riddett@cpl.ie

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**About the job**

We are seeking skilled senior level .NET Fleet Management Software Developer with background in robotics / automation to join us in developing our automated warehouse software.

**What we offer**

Moffett Automation is an award-winning high-tech company. We are steadily expanding due to our successful product infiltrating the market. We are an industry leader in what we do which is developing software and producing automated pallet shuttles and other products to move pallets around a warehouse. We dedicate time to R&D for new features and products so there is always something new to be working on and that we are keeping ahead of the curve.

We have developed our software fully in-house, and it consists of three main components: Warehouse Control System Software, Machine Software (Shuttles, Lifts and Conveyors) and Frontend (and Backend). We use .NET Core and .NET 6 for all our software and Blazor for our frontend user interfaces.

As each project we take on is unique, we are always working on new features which test our software team whilst also looking to improve current system. You will get to test your code on real machines in our factory in Monaghan where we have our own automated warehouse just for our testing purposes. Our software is largely about reading sensors and controlling motors and actuators according to orders from our control system.

**Who we are looking for**

Primarily we are seeking mid to senior level developers who can understand and improve our existing algorithms for fleet management and order scheduling logic and create new ones to optimise the efficiency of different setups.

**Must have skills**:

· .NET / C#

· Experience in the industry or similar industry

· Strong capability to understand and develop algorithms

· Experience with the use of state machines

· Excellent problem solver

· Control systems experience

**Experience with any of the following would be an advantage:**

· Automation of hardware/machinery

· Electrical/mechanical knowledge is highly advantageous

· Warehouse Control systems/ Warehouse Management systems

· SQL

**Salary and benefits**

· Compensation depends solely on the skills and qualities of the person

· Pension scheme

· Flexible hybrid working

· Time and resources for personal development

· Death in Benefit

· Employee Assistance Programme

· Free parking

· On-site recreational facilities

Benefits:

* Additional leave
* Company events
* Company pension
* Employee assistance program
* Flexitime
* On-site parking

Experience:

* .NET: 4 years (required)
* C#: 4 years (required)

Work authorisation:

* Ireland (required)

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Engineer Principal.Product Development Engineering.V
jobs.description:
National Oilwell Varco Norway AS is seeking a Principal Product Responsible Engineer to join our Fluid Automation team and take ownership of the DORS Automation platform.
  
The role is responsible for driving the full product lifecycle—from concept and roadmap definition through development, release, and continuous improvement—while aligning the solution with NOV’s strategic objectives and customer needs.

You will lead the implementation of new features, ensure seamless integration with third-party automation tools, and help deliver high-quality process-control software to NOV’s global customers. Working closely with cross-functional teams, customers, and external partners, you will shape the product roadmap, support commercialization, and maintain the platform’s competitive position in the market.

  

* Lead the end‑to‑end development and release of the DORS Automation product
* Gather and translate customer and sales requirements into technical specifications
* Design, implement, and test new functionality using modern software technologies
* Integrate third‑party automation tools and ensure compatibility with existing systems
* Collaborate with cross‑functional teams including sales, engineering and after market
* Maintain product documentation, release notes, and technical manuals
* Provide technical support and troubleshooting for deployed solutions
* Drive continuous improvement and adopt best practices in software engineering
* Align product roadmap with NOV’s strategic objectives and market demands
* Mentor junior engineers and promote knowledge sharing within the team

  

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Mechatronics, Robotics, Automation Engineering, or related field
* 10+ years of experience in software development for industrial automation
* Proficiency in C++, C#
* Strong understanding of process control - PLC, SCADA, and HMI systems
* Experience integrating third‑party automation APIs and SDKs
* Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and software development methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum
* Proven track record of delivering complex software products on schedule
* Excellent communication skills for interfacing with customers and sales teams
* Ability to work in a multinational, matrix‑organized environment
* Knowledge of safety standards and regulations in oil & gas automation
* Fluent in English and Norwegian

**What we offer**

* **Meaningful product ownership** – take responsibility for the continued development and direction of DORS Automation, a solution actively used on drilling rigs.
* **Broad technical and business exposure** – work across software development, industrial automation, product strategy, sales, customers and aftermarket support.
* **Real operational impact** – develop automation that helps simplify drilling operations, improve efficiency and reduce the risk of manual errors.
* **Influence over future development** – identify improvements, new use cases and opportunities to expand DORS across additional rigs and applications.
* **Experienced technical environment** – collaborate with a team of software and automation engineers working across software, PLC and HMI technologies.
* **Structured onboarding** – NOV onboarding plus an approximately two-week departmental introduction covering products, PLC/HMI practices and software-development standards.
* **Some longer-term workplace flexibility** – the role is expected to begin primarily from the Oslo office; the Hiring Manager indicated that hybrid working can be considered once the person is established in the role and team.
